item.text: I’m always happy to help when I can, and I’m glad the tool has been useful. Since it has come back later than we originally agreed a couple of times, though, I need to keep future loans on a firmer schedule so I can count on having my own equipment when I need it. If you’d like to borrow something again, could we agree on a specific return date before you take it, and please return it by then? If your plans change, just send me a message before the due date so we can work something out. If that timing won’t work, I may need to say no to lending it out, but I appreciate your understanding.
